messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

Yes, that's likely the reason. The messaging app needs storage permission to access the photos/videos you want to send via MMS. Don't worry - granting this permission is safe and necessary for MMS to work.

Please use `grant_app_permission(app_name="messaging", permission="storage")` on your phone to give the messaging app storage access.

After you've done that, let me know, and we'll test if MMS is working again.

I have granted the messaging app permission to access storage. What should I do next? Also, I see the airplane mode icon on the status bar—should it be on? I'm worried that could be causing issues.

Please process the next appropriate account action now.
